tools.name: runbear_book_demo
tools.description: Opens Runbear's demo booking page in a new tab. Returns the booking URL.

tools.name: runbear_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the user to a known Runbear page. Pass `target` as one of: pricing, integrations, features, use-cases, changelog, docs, signup.

tools.name: runbear_overview
tools.description: Returns a high-level overview of Runbear: what it does, key product areas, and primary URLs. Use to answer questions about what Runbear is or where to find specific information.
